profile.headline: Cyber Threat Intelligence | Identifying, Analyzing, and Mitigating Emerging Threats
profile.summary: Experienced Military Intelligence Officer and Government Contractor with a demonstrated history of working in the Military and Intelligence Community. Skilled in Intelligence Analysis, Intelligence, Operational Planning, Information Technology/Cyber, Tactics, and Command. Strong military and protective services professional with a Bachelor of Science (BS) focused in Mathematics from Jacksonville State University.

positions.title: Military Intelligence Officer
positions.description: Assigned as Detachment 38 Commander apart of 323rd Military Intelligence Battalion to lead personnel to deploy in support of Operation Inherent Resolve (OIR).  Responsible for the readiness and professional development of 4 Officers. Develops a culture of values-based respect supporting SHARP, EO, EEO, and the Army Values. Reports Officer duties include evaluating reports for completeness, validity, relevance, and quality; Supporting the identification of targets of operational interest and providing collection guidance; Assisting in source review by evaluating production and identifying any potential reporting concerns; Reviewing, coordinating, and approving report dissemination; Providing guidance on report writing tradecraft.

positions.title: Data Exploitation Analyst
positions.description: Provide support by performing intelligence analysis of NCTC datasets resulting in the identification and subsequent nomination of known of suspected terrorists into the National Terrorist Watchlisting system. Receive, triage, review, and process incoming terrorism information from a multitude of United States government agencies, databases, and other sources for inclusion into the Terrorist Identities Datamart Environment (TIDE). Aided in the analysis of all-source reporting on identity information on known and suspected terrorist and contributed to responses to senior level requests for information on identities in daily threat reporting. Assessed all-source reporting to identify identity gaps, and determine the identity data required to nominate a terrorist-associated individual for US Government screening opportunities. Analyze CI/HUMINT data pertinent to counter-terrorism, subversion, sabotage, espionage, paramilitary /insurgency, and threats to force protection and personnel and physical infrastructure security.

positions.title: Intelligence Analyst
positions.description: Support a U.S Government (USG) agency in the integration and analysis of intelligence pertaining to terrorism and counterterrorism using TIDE. Conduct strategic operational functions that involve integrating counterterrorism activates across the US Intelligence Community. Receive, triage, review, and process incoming terrorism information from a multitude of United States government agencies, databases, and other sources for inclusion into the TIDE. Analyze terrorism information in TIDE and export Known and Suspected Terrorist identities and biometrics.
